request.style: English, male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, cello, soft percussion, mournful and solemn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ezra wept before the house of God
A large assembly gathered around
Men and women weeping bitterly
Sin had filled the holy ground

[Pre-Chorus]
Shecaniah spoke up to Ezra's ear
We have been unfaithful to God
Yet hope remains for Israel now
Let us follow the covenant

[Chorus]
Send away all these foreign wives
Along with their children too
Do it according to the Law
It is our duty to do

[Verse]
Ezra stood up and spoke aloud
You have added to Israel's guilt
Make confession to the Lord your God
Do his will and separate

[Chorus]
Send away all these foreign wives
Along with their children too
Do it according to the Law
It is our duty to do

[Verse]
Heads of families sat to judge
Examining each case with care
From the sons of Bebai's line
Athlai agreed to leave

[Chorus]
Send away all these foreign wives
Along with their children too
Do it according to the Law
It is our duty to do

[Outro]
The matter was dealt with
The law was kept
